headline: YouTube might be testing hiding the dislike button
summary: YouTube is reportedly testing a new UI for its dislike button. Screenshots show the button moved to a submenu or absent entirely. This change could impact user feedback visibility on videos.

headline: Judge dismisses Sam Altman’s sister’s sexual abuse lawsuit
summary: A US District Judge dismissed Ann Altman's sexual abuse lawsuit against her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. The dismissal came after Ann failed to appear for an independent medical examination. The lawsuit, filed last year, alleged childhood abuse.

headline: Trump is giving Nick Shirley $10,000 and launching a $25 million fraud bounty program
summary: Donald Trump announced a $10,000 payment to YouTuber Nick Shirley for his fraud allegations. Trump also launched a $25 million bounty program for public fraud reports. This initiative follows Shirley's viral video alleging daycare fraud.

headline: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
summary: Google is integrating personalized Gemini AI into Android Auto and cars with built-in Google. This update allows Gemini to access your data from Google apps like Gmail, Calendar, and Maps. Users can now ask Gemini about flight statuses and other personal info while driving.

headline: Marvel's VisionQuest Episodes 3 and 4 Review: 'Reboot' and 'Malware'
summary: VisionQuest Episodes 3 and 4 show significant improvement. Paul Bettany's White Vision progresses in regaining his humanity. The series explores themes of identity and memory.

headline: Cooking Up Magick Book Review
summary: A review of the book 'Cooking Up Magick' has been published. The review evaluates the content and themes of the book. Details regarding its appeal and target audience are discussed.

headline: KPop Demon Hunters 2 Gets a Theatrical Release After First Movie's Smashing Success on Streaming
summary: 'KPop Demon Hunters 2' will receive a theatrical release. This follows the first film's massive streaming success. The sequel aims to capitalize on its predecessor's popularity.

headline: The Chronicles of Narnia Books are on Sale at Amazon, Including a Deluxe Edition Hardcover
summary: 'The Chronicles of Narnia' book series is currently on sale at Amazon. This includes a special deluxe hardcover edition. Fans can now purchase the classic fantasy novels at a reduced price.

headline: Chris Mason: Jackdaw approved but tricky energy trade-offs remain
summary: The Jackdaw and Rosebank projects have been approved for UK energy. These projects highlight the UK's ongoing challenges in energy policy. Difficult trade-offs are required for the nation's energy future.

headline: Lawyer caught by BBC offering to make illegal-worker fine go away
summary: A BBC investigation caught a lawyer offering to bypass illegal-worker fines. The Home Secretary has ordered a review of fine issuance and collection. This comes after the lawyer's illicit advice was exposed.

headline: Watch: 'We don't pay' - lawyer advises how to avoid £45,000 illegal-worker fine
summary: A lawyer, Mohammad Alias Yousaf, advised an undercover reporter on avoiding a £45,000 illegal-worker fine. He claimed it was possible to bypass payment. This exposé highlights issues in fine enforcement.

headline: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
summary: An Australian MP reportedly lost both legs following an alleged car attack. Her husband confirmed the tragic incident. The alleged attacker faces multiple charges and has appeared in court.
